checks.title: Real desktop screenshot and screen recording acceptance
checks.instructions: After automated Slice 07 QA passes, take a desktop screenshot through Jarvis, then record the desktop for at least 20 seconds while visibly changing windows/content. Stop recording and inspect the resulting screenshot/video on the supported host.
checks.expected: The screenshot shows the intended desktop source, the video plays through with the visible changes, permission/state errors are understandable if encountered, and both files are indexed as durable Artifacts rather than scene diagnostics.
